limitations: Position values, price, rates, thresholds, caps, role members, and totals require same-block reads for current use.
The reproduced source has a closedByLiquidation enum value but no implemented liquidation operation; do not infer liquidation support.

positionModel.identity: bytes32 position ID; an active record stores Enclave, borrower, originator, principal, rates, thresholds, timestamps, status, and pledged veBTC token IDs.
positionModel.authorization: Opening requires ENCLAVE_ROLE. Mutations require the recorded position Enclave and that caller must still hold ENCLAVE_ROLE.
positionModel.collateral: Current collateral is the sum of veBTC.locked(tokenId).amount for the position's pledged token IDs; each token must be owned by the calling Enclave when pledged.
positionModel.closure: Repayment to zero principal releases pledged-token mappings and closes as closedByRepayment. Zero debt returns max uint256 as the collateral-ratio sentinel.

accountingDimensions.meaning: Time-proportional debt fee at the position interest rate; settled interest is minted to PCV.
Time-proportional fee at the position originator rate; settled fee is minted to the recorded originator.
Cumulative institutional principal minted, separate from fee minting.
Cumulative institutional principal repaid and burned.
Cumulative system fee debt settled; distinct from principal burned and fee tokens minted.
Custodied veBTC explicitly pledged to an active position; not all Enclave assets.

repayment.ordering: Accrue system and position fees, require payment at least equal to all position fees, settle fees first, and apply only the remainder to principal.
repayment.bounds: Reject a remainder greater than principal. The Enclave caller supplies and burns the full MUSD payment. repayAll is present only in debt-manager implementation v2.
repayment.aggregateUpdates: Principal repayment decreases totalPrincipal and increases totalDebtBurned; interest/originator settlement uses separate fee totals and recipients.

evidence.locator: debtManager.parameters, totals, positions, originators, roles, and events
